$comment: Codex CLI hooks manifest — the Codex-side safety floor, mirror of the Claude Code PreToolUse hooks wired in ../.claude-plugin/plugin.json. Codex's hook system shares Claude's event names, schema, and exit-code-2-blocks convention, so the same scripts run unchanged. Install: copy this to <project>/.codex/hooks.json (or ~/.codex/hooks.json) and make the void hook scripts resolvable at the referenced path. See ../../../docs/CODEX.md. The two file-edit hooks match Codex's apply_patch tool; block-dangerous-bash matches the shell tool. Paths use ${VOID_HOOKS_DIR}, which you set to the directory holding the hook scripts (e.g. an absolute path to packages/core/hooks, or a copied .void/hooks).
